# Credit control – implementation notes

**Not run.** There was no PHP or database in this environment, so none of this has been executed or syntax-checked. It needs a pass on a copy of the live database before it ships. The first things to try are `Z_UpgradeDatabase` (update 44), one review, one stop, one reminder run, one month-end charge, one waiver and one write-off, then Debtors Control Integrity.

## The main finding: stop and watch already exist

webERP already carries credit status on `debtorsmaster.holdreason`. `holdreasons.dissallowinvoices` means 0 = normal, 1 = **stop**, 2 = **watch**. Order entry, counter sales, special orders, statements, the aged debtors report and customer inquiry already read that flag.
I built on it rather than adding a parallel "on stop" field. Two fields would drift apart, and every existing check would have ignored the new one.
What was missing was everything around it:

- History and reasons.
- Controlled change. `Customers.php` let anyone who could edit a customer change the limit and the status.
- Enforcement on the routes that never checked it: recurring orders, EDI, the API/web shop, dispatch and invoicing.
- A bug: the customer-own-order path in `SelectOrderItems.php` blocked watch (2) as well as stop (1). That contradicted BR-08 and would have told customers they are "on watch".

## What was built

### Schema (`sql/updates/44.php` and the matching `install/sql/tables`, `install/sql/data`, `install/sql/creditcontrol_demo.sql`)

New fields:

- `debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate`, `debtorsmaster.chargeexempt`.
- `debtortrans.disputed`.
- `salesorders.creditholdstate`: 0 none, 1 held for approval, 2 released by credit control.

New tables:

- `creditreviews`: append-only review history.
- `creditevents`: the audit trail for status, limit, review, reminder, charge, waiver, write-off, dispute and note events, with who, when and why.
- `dunningstages`, `dunninglog`.
- `creditcharges`: unique on customer + month + type, so the same month can never be charged twice.
- `creditwriteoffs`.

Other changes:

- New transaction types 51 (Interest and Fees), 52 (Charge Waiver) and 53 (Bad Debt Write-off). They have their own number sequences and show by name on statements and customer inquiry. I did not reuse invoice (10) or credit note (11): those types carry stock moves and reprint links, and `Z_SalesIntegrityCheck` would flag them.
- Security tokens 21 (credit control) and 22 (authority: approve write-offs, change settings). By default the Accountant role gets 21 and the System Administrator role gets 21 and 22; assign them to the real roles in Access Permissions.
- Settings are in `config` (keys `Credit*`).
- Three starter reminder letters.
- Go-live (BR-39/40):
  - Every existing customer gets a next review date of today plus the review period.
  - Customers already on hold keep their status, so existing stops stay stops. A starting-position history row is written for each customer on stop or watch.
  - The stop list from the spreadsheet can be loaded with the existing `Z_ImportDebtors` (it sets the credit status).
- The fresh installer loads the same data. The demo database is loaded from `demo.sql` plus `creditcontrol_demo.sql`, wired into `InstallFunctions.php`.

### Shared logic: `includes/CreditControlFunctions.php`

- Status helpers and the rep filter.
- `CreditSetStatus` and `CreditSetLimit` always write the history.
- Order check and dispatch check.
- Overdue calculation, reminder eligibility, letter building.
- `CreditPostTransaction` (debtortrans plus balanced GL) and `CreditAllocate`.

### Pages

| Page | Token | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `CreditControl.php` | 1 | Worklist and report: reviews due, over limit and by how much, watch/stop, orders held, open orders on watch, final notice sent. Filter by rep and currency; totals in home currency; release held orders (needs 21). |
| `CreditCustomer.php` | 1 | One customer: position, review form, status change, dispute, exemption, notes, history. Everything is read-only without token 21. |
| `CreditReminders.php` | 21 | Reminder run: preview, untick, send. Emails to accounts contacts; no-email customers are listed with the letter text. |
| `CreditCharges.php` | 21 | Month-end interest and fees: preview, confirm, post. Also waive. |
| `CreditWriteOffs.php` | 21 | Request, approve (22), report. |
| `CreditControlSettings.php` | 22 | Rate, fee, days, GL accounts, approval limit, statuses, stage wording. |
| `CustomerCreditPortal.php` | 1 | Portal: own balance, reminders and charges. |

### Enforcement and existing pages changed

- `DeliveryDetails.php` is the web-shop and sales-office order path. Orders for a customer on stop are refused. Over-limit orders are accepted but held when `CheckCreditLimits` = 3.
- `SystemParameters.php`: new option "Hold for credit control approval" (3). The other limit checks treat 3 as warn.
- `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` blocks dispatch and invoicing for a stopped customer or a held order unless released, both on opening the order and again when processing.
- `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` skips templates of stopped customers, which stay due so they fire after release. Over-limit orders are held and not auto-invoiced.
- `EDIProcessOrders.php` and `api/includes/api_salesorders.php` (new error code 1174) refuse orders for a customer on stop.
- `SelectOrderItems.php`: watch customers can order in the portal.
- `Customers.php`:
  - Existing customers' limit and status are editable only with token 21, enforced on the server, not just by greying the fields. Changes made there are written to the history.
  - New customers get a review date.
  - A customer with credit history cannot be deleted.
- `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` moves the new tables and copies the new fields.
- `api_customers.php` and `Z_ImportDebtors.php` set a review date for new customers.
- `AgedDebtors.php` shows status, limit and last reminder stage (BR-31).
- `Z_CheckDebtorsControl.php` only counted types 10/11/12, so interest, fees, waivers and write-offs would have shown as an unexplained ledger difference. It now has its own column (BR-37/38).
- `CustomerInquiry.php`: a portal user could previously view any customer by changing `?CustomerID=`. The customer is now forced to the user's own (BR-36). A link to the credit page was added.
- The staff guide has a new Credit Control section in `doc/Manual/ManualAccountsReceivable.html`, including the note for sales (BR-42/43).

## Decisions on the BRD's open questions

1. **Interest.** A simple annual rate (config), charged monthly as net overdue × rate × days in month / 365. The base is the balance at least *N* days overdue (default 30), after unallocated credits, excluding disputed items. One rate for all currencies.
2. **Late fee.** One flat fee per customer per month by default; "per overdue invoice" is an option. The fee is set in home currency and converted at the current rate into the customer's currency.
3. **Interest on interest.** Off by default (option). Charges are still chased, but are not in the interest base.
4. **Automatic stop after the final notice.** No. The customer is listed on the worklist for Maria to decide. A system that stops customers by itself is a risk, and the BRD allows "only flagged".
5. **Over-limit web shop and standing orders.** Held for approval, not rejected. This is `CheckCreditLimits` = 3, so the existing 0/1/2 behaviour is unchanged. Stopped customers are refused outright. The API only knows the order value after the lines arrive, so it holds only if the customer is already at or over the limit.
6. **Write-off threshold.** 1,000 in home currency as a starting value; Finance changes it in settings. The Finance Director approves. There is no second Financial Accountant sign-off. The approver is whoever holds token 22, so a separate sign-off can be added by giving only the right person that token.
7. **Written-off debt later paid.** Handled as a normal receipt (it becomes an unallocated credit). Recovery to the P&L is a manual journal. This is documented and not automated, because it needs an accounting policy from Finance.
8. **Reps and stop reasons.** Reps see the status and the reason (the user story asks "and why") and reminders. They do not see review notes, internal notes, charges or write-offs.
9. **Letter languages.** English wording, editable per stage. The language mechanism for letters is a follow-up.
10. **Watch in the portal.** Not shown. The portal only says "on hold" for a stop.
11. **Nobody available.** Anyone with token 21 or 22, which Finance assigns. There is no automatic delegation.
12. **Head office / branch groups.** webERP has no parent-child customer group; branches already share one customer account and so one limit. Nothing was added.

Other choices:

- Overdue is net of unallocated receipts and credit notes, so a customer who has paid but whose cash has not been allocated is not chased or charged (BR-15).
- Reminder cycle:
  - Stages are numbered in order of days overdue.
  - A letter is sent only when the highest stage reached is above any stage already sent since the oldest current overdue invoice fell due.
  - Never two letters inside the minimum days (default 14).
  - The decision is made again at the moment of sending.
- Write-off posting:
  - It is allocated oldest-first to open invoices.
  - It is valued at the rate those invoices were posted at, so no exchange difference arises and the debtors control account keeps agreeing with the customer balances, including for foreign currency.
  - The amount cannot exceed what is owed on open items.
- Waiver: reverses exactly what was posted, to the same GL account and at the same rate, and is allocated to the charge. A charge that has already been paid cannot be waived.
- GL accounts for interest, fees and bad debt are deliberately blank after install. Posting is refused until Finance chooses them.

## Known limits and things to check

- Picking lists (`GeneratePickingList`, `PDFPickingList`) are not blocked for stopped customers. The block is at dispatch and invoicing, which is where goods leave and money is billed.
- `CounterSales.php` and `SpecialOrder.php` rely on their existing stop checks. Counter sales are paid at the counter, so they are never held.
- Editing an existing order does not re-hold it. Only creation is checked.
- `Z_ImportDebtors` updates of existing customers still change status and limit without a history entry. It is an administrator utility behind token 15.
- Not changed: `Z_POSDataCreation.php` (POS export) and the translation `.po` files; new strings need translating.
- The new menu items are added for every role by the update script, as `NewMenuItem` does, while the page tokens decide who can open them. The fresh installer is more selective (credit control items only for the Accountant and Administrator roles).

What was missing was everything around it:

- History and reasons.
- Controlled change. `Customers.php` let anyone who could edit a customer change the limit and the status.
- Enforcement on the routes that never checked it: recurring orders, EDI, the API/web shop, dispatch and invoicing.
- A bug: the customer-own-order path in `SelectOrderItems.php` blocked watch (2) as well as stop (1). That contradicted BR-08 and would have told customers they are "on watch".

## What was built

### Schema (`sql/updates/44.php` and the matching `install/sql/tables`, `install/sql/data`, `install/sql/creditcontrol_demo.sql`)

New fields:

- `debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate`, `debtorsmaster.chargeexempt`.
- `debtortrans.disputed`.
- `salesorders.creditholdstate`: 0 none, 1 held for approval, 2 released by credit control.

New tables:

- `creditreviews`: append-only review history.
- `creditevents`: the audit trail for status, limit, review, reminder, charge, waiver, write-off, dispute and note events, with who, when and why.
- `dunningstages`, `dunninglog`.
- `creditcharges`: unique on customer + month + type, so the same month can never be charged twice.
- `creditwriteoffs`.

Other changes:

- New transaction types 51 (Interest and Fees), 52 (Charge Waiver) and 53 (Bad Debt Write-off). They have their own number sequences and show by name on statements and customer inquiry. I did not reuse invoice (10) or credit note (11): those types carry stock moves and reprint links, and `Z_SalesIntegrityCheck` would flag them.
- Security tokens 21 (credit control) and 22 (authority: approve write-offs, change settings). By default the Accountant role gets 21 and the System Administrator role gets 21 and 22; assign them to the real roles in Access Permissions.
- Settings are in `config` (keys `Credit*`).
- Three starter reminder letters.
- Go-live (BR-39/40):
  - Every existing customer gets a next review date of today plus the review period.
  - Customers already on hold keep their status, so existing stops stay stops. A starting-position history row is written for each customer on stop or watch.
  - The stop list from the spreadsheet can be loaded with the existing `Z_ImportDebtors` (it sets the credit status).
- The fresh installer loads the same data. The demo database is loaded from `demo.sql` plus `creditcontrol_demo.sql`, wired into `InstallFunctions.php`.

### Shared logic: `includes/CreditControlFunctions.php`

- Status helpers and the rep filter.
- `CreditSetStatus` and `CreditSetLimit` always write the history.
- Order check and dispatch check.
- Overdue calculation, reminder eligibility, letter building.
- `CreditPostTransaction` (debtortrans plus balanced GL) and `CreditAllocate`.

### Pages

| Page | Token | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `CreditControl.php` | 1 | Worklist and report: reviews due, over limit and by how much, watch/stop, orders held, open orders on watch, final notice sent. Filter by rep and currency; totals in home currency; release held orders (needs 21). |
| `CreditCustomer.php` | 1 | One customer: position, review form, status change, dispute, exemption, notes, history. Everything is read-only without token 21. |
| `CreditReminders.php` | 21 | Reminder run: preview, untick, send. Emails to accounts contacts; no-email customers are listed with the letter text. |
| `CreditCharges.php` | 21 | Month-end interest and fees: preview, confirm, post. Also waive. |
| `CreditWriteOffs.php` | 21 | Request, approve (22), report. |
| `CreditControlSettings.php` | 22 | Rate, fee, days, GL accounts, approval limit, statuses, stage wording. |
| `CustomerCreditPortal.php` | 1 | Portal: own balance, reminders and charges. |

### Enforcement and existing pages changed

- `DeliveryDetails.php` is the web-shop and sales-office order path. Orders for a customer on stop are refused. Over-limit orders are accepted but held when `CheckCreditLimits` = 3.
- `SystemParameters.php`: new option "Hold for credit control approval" (3). The other limit checks treat 3 as warn.
- `ConfirmDispatch_Invoice.php` blocks dispatch and invoicing for a stopped customer or a held order unless released, both on opening the order and again when processing.
- `RecurringSalesOrdersProcess.php` skips templates of stopped customers, which stay due so they fire after release. Over-limit orders are held and not auto-invoiced.
- `EDIProcessOrders.php` and `api/includes/api_salesorders.php` (new error code 1174) refuse orders for a customer on stop.
- `SelectOrderItems.php`: watch customers can order in the portal.
- `Customers.php`:
  - Existing customers' limit and status are editable only with token 21, enforced on the server, not just by greying the fields. Changes made there are written to the history.
  - New customers get a review date.
  - A customer with credit history cannot be deleted.
- `Z_ChangeCustomerCode.php` moves the new tables and copies the new fields.
- `api_customers.php` and `Z_ImportDebtors.php` set a review date for new customers.
- `AgedDebtors.php` shows status, limit and last reminder stage (BR-31).
- `Z_CheckDebtorsControl.php` only counted types 10/11/12, so interest, fees, waivers and write-offs would have shown as an unexplained ledger difference. It now has its own column (BR-37/38).
- `CustomerInquiry.php`: a portal user could previously view any customer by changing `?CustomerID=`. The customer is now forced to the user's own (BR-36). A link to the credit page was added.
- The staff guide has a new Credit Control section in `doc/Manual/ManualAccountsReceivable.html`, including the note for sales (BR-42/43).

## Decisions on the BRD's open questions

1. **Interest.** A simple annual rate (config), charged monthly as net overdue × rate × days in month / 365. The base is the balance at least *N* days overdue (default 30), after unallocated credits, excluding disputed items. One rate for all currencies.
2. **Late fee.** One flat fee per customer per month by default; "per overdue invoice" is an option. The fee is set in home currency and converted at the current rate into the customer's currency.
3. **Interest on interest.** Off by default (option). Charges are still chased, but are not in the interest base.
4. **Automatic stop after the final notice.** No. The customer is listed on the worklist for Maria to decide. A system that stops customers by itself is a risk, and the BRD allows "only flagged".
5. **Over-limit web shop and standing orders.** Held for approval, not rejected. This is `CheckCreditLimits` = 3, so the existing 0/1/2 behaviour is unchanged. Stopped customers are refused outright. The API only knows the order value after the lines arrive, so it holds only if the customer is already at or over the limit.
6. **Write-off threshold.** 1,000 in home currency as a starting value; Finance changes it in settings. The Finance Director approves. There is no second Financial Accountant sign-off. The approver is whoever holds token 22, so a separate sign-off can be added by giving only the right person that token.
7. **Written-off debt later paid.** Handled as a normal receipt (it becomes an unallocated credit). Recovery to the P&L is a manual journal. This is documented and not automated, because it needs an accounting policy from Finance.
8. **Reps and stop reasons.** Reps see the status and the reason (the user story asks "and why") and reminders. They do not see review notes, internal notes, charges or write-offs.
9. **Letter languages.** English wording, editable per stage. The language mechanism for letters is a follow-up.
10. **Watch in the portal.** Not shown. The portal only says "on hold" for a stop.
11. **Nobody available.** Anyone with token 21 or 22, which Finance assigns. There is no automatic delegation.
12. **Head office / branch groups.** webERP has no parent-child customer group; branches already share one customer account and so one limit. Nothing was added.

Other choices:

- Overdue is net of unallocated receipts and credit notes, so a customer who has paid but whose cash has not been allocated is not chased or charged (BR-15).
- Reminder cycle:
  - Stages are numbered in order of days overdue.
  - A letter is sent only when the highest stage reached is above any stage already sent since the oldest current overdue invoice fell due.
  - Never two letters inside the minimum days (default 14).
  - The decision is made again at the moment of sending.
- Write-off posting:
  - It is allocated oldest-first to open invoices.
  - It is valued at the rate those invoices were posted at, so no exchange difference arises and the debtors control account keeps agreeing with the customer balances, including for foreign currency.
  - The amount cannot exceed what is owed on open items.
- Waiver: reverses exactly what was posted, to the same GL account and at the same rate, and is allocated to the charge. A charge that has already been paid cannot be waived.
- GL accounts for interest, fees and bad debt are deliberately blank after install. Posting is refused until Finance chooses them.

- Picking lists (`GeneratePickingList`, `PDFPickingList`) are not blocked for stopped customers. The block is at dispatch and invoicing, which is where goods leave and money is billed.
- `CounterSales.php` and `SpecialOrder.php` rely on their existing stop checks. Counter sales are paid at the counter, so they are never held.
- Editing an existing order does not re-hold it. Only creation is checked.
- `Z_ImportDebtors` updates of existing customers still change status and limit without a history entry. It is an administrator utility behind token 15.
- Not changed: `Z_POSDataCreation.php` (POS export) and the translation `.po` files; new strings need translating.
- The new menu items are added for every role by the update script, as `NewMenuItem` does, while the page tokens decide who can open them. The fresh installer is more selective (credit control items only for the Accountant and Administrator roles).
